sourceContent.title: Prayer shaped by abiding in Christ
sourceContent.body:
## Stay close to the source

John 15:7 joins prayer with abiding in Christ and allowing his words to remain in us. Prayer is not presented as a technique for controlling outcomes. It grows from relationship, dependence, and a mind being reshaped by Jesus' teaching.

## Let desire be formed

Before asking only whether God will grant a request, ask what this passage is doing to the request itself. Christ's words can expose selfishness, deepen compassion, and turn vague desire into faithful prayer.

## Practice today

Read John 15:1-8 slowly. Write one request you are carrying. Then write one way Jesus' words clarify what faithfulness would look like while you wait for an answer.
